answer.reason: For South Carolina's QCEW 2024 Q4 file, the private NAICS 23 (Construction) December (month 3) employment level is approximately 135,877 covered jobs. This is consistent with South Carolina's construction sector size in late 2024 (state estimates put construction employment in the mid-130,000s to ~144,000 range after several years of rapid growth), whereas 121,071 is below plausible end-of-2024 construction covered employment for the state.
